name: Tooltip
description: Non-interactive supplementary content shown on hover and focus after a configurable delay. Rendered via Portal into document.body. Must not contain interactive elements.

notes: The trigger element receives aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip id.
Tooltip must NOT contain buttons, links, or any interactive content.
Tooltip hides immediately on blur or mouse-leave; no delay on hide.
Tooltip is rendered in a Portal to avoid clipping by overflow:hidden ancestors.

content.description: The tooltip content. Must be non-interactive text or static elements.

position.description: Preferred position of the tooltip relative to the trigger.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing the tooltip after hover or focus.

children.description: The trigger element. Must be a single React element that can receive event handler props.

do: Use tooltips to supplement icon buttons with a text label.
Keep tooltip content concise — one sentence or less.
Ensure the trigger element is keyboard focusable so tooltip content is accessible to keyboard users.
dont: Do not put interactive elements (links, buttons) inside a tooltip.
Do not use tooltips as the only way to convey essential information.
Do not use tooltips on disabled elements — screen readers may not reach them.
